built.via: controls.audit: when false, non-mandatory audit records are suppressed and counted (amf_audit_suppressed_by_org_total); hard blocks, sheds and admission rejects are always recorded; applies to chat, responses and MCP
rules.threat: threat rule action block when on, flag when off

rules.keywords: one GW26 keyword rule (pol-fw-blocked-keywords-keywords), input scope, case-insensitive substring match (token also matches tokenizer); published as monitor/flag until V2_PLAN_NEW_RULES_MODE=enforce

controls.rate: burst per worker is its even share plus 3 binomial standard deviations (exact at one worker; aggregate burst between burst and workers*burst_worker); a single connection pinned to one worker sees burst_worker; per gateway replica (fleet ceiling up to R times the configured value; each worker holds 1/workers of the rate); billable OpenAI surfaces only (chat, responses, embeddings), not MCP or moderations
controls.compliance: declarative, as in v1: published (sorted, unique), stamped on every audit record, violations surfaced in the publish note; operator values are never overridden

controls.max_response_tokens: request-side clamp of the upstream max_tokens (min of org value and the hard cap) on stream and non-stream; the gateway does not count response tokens (provider that ignores max_tokens is a residual risk, GW33)

controls.org_tpm_limit: token bucket over the admission-time estimate (prompt estimate plus clamped output ceiling times n), no response true-up; per-worker tolerance floor admits any request below the limit; accepted overshoot is workers times the single-request cost bound; per gateway replica (fleet ceiling up to R times the configured value; each worker holds 1/workers of the rate); billable OpenAI surfaces only (chat, responses, embeddings), not MCP or moderations; 0 = off

controls.audit: when false, non-blocking output-phase REDACT/FLAG audit records are suppressed and counted; hard blocks, sheds and admission rejects are always recorded; applies to chat, responses and MCP

rules.output_policy: fallback action for output/both-scope policy rows whose own action is monitor or empty; an explicit own action wins; rewrite refused (GW33); global monitor posture forces mode=monitor on rows the fallback decided
rules.output_policy: false drops output-scope GW26 policy rows and rewrites both-scope rows to input scope (their input half keeps enforcing)

controls.rate: gates request rate and burst only (org_tpm_limit is enforced independently); per gateway replica (fleet ceiling up to R times the configured value; each worker holds 1/workers of the rate); billable OpenAI surfaces only (chat, responses, embeddings), not MCP or moderations

controls.rate: GCRA request rate, per gateway replica (fleet ceiling up to R times the configured value; each worker holds 1/workers of the rate); billable OpenAI surfaces only (chat, responses, embeddings), not MCP or moderations; default 1000 rpm is a 60 ms emission interval per worker at W=1

controls.audit: stamped on each audit record at write time (non-retroactive); audit_control sweeps only rows whose own stamp elapsed, NULL stamps are kept; sweep is off by default (AMF_AUDIT_RETENTION_SWEEP)
rules.threat: content-score floor, not a reputation lookup: three input rules (prompt_injection, jailbreak, command), removed when off; published as monitor/flag until V2_PLAN_NEW_RULES_MODE=enforce
rules.threat: operator confidence floor over the semantic detector (value/100); 0 means no operator floor above the derived cut, not block-everything; non-semantic detectors ignore the threshold
